correctness.rationale: The functional \(\mathcal L=E+(\beta S_*/\zeta_2)A+(\beta\epsilon S_*/\zeta_3)V\) is reconstructed directly from the printed equations. Its exact derivative is \(\beta(S-S_*)h+\zeta_1(\mathcal R_0-1)E\). On the source feasible set, \(S\le S_*\), so the derivative is nonpositive for \(\mathcal R_0\le1\) and vanishes only when \(E=A=V=0\). LaSalle gives decay of those compartments; the hospital/ICU block is Hurwitz and the remaining cascade converges. A separate differential inequality for \(S_*-S\) proves Lyapunov stability at the critical endpoint. The symbolic checker independently verifies the critical algebra.

value.rationale: The endpoint matters because the source conclusion and policy discussion use the closed eradication condition \(\mathcal R_0\le1\), while the printed theorems stop at \(\mathcal R_0<1\). The exact functional converts that unsupported boundary claim into a rigorous theorem, independently reproves the strict regime, and isolates a reusable critical-threshold mechanism for a seven-class model with severe, hospital, ICU, and waning-immunity compartments.
